name: keyed-lww-absent-key-component
description: WRIT-345 item 3 (spec/fold.md §5.8 "A key component the body omits entirely ... contributes the empty component"): an operation that omits a declared key field entirely addresses the empty-string component of that position, distinct from a key column no vector had previously exercised as absent. op-2 omits `revision` and so overwrites op-1's register at key ["user:alice",""]; op-3 omits `subject` and addresses the unrelated register at key ["","r1"] -- an absent component is not itself a write conflict with a present-but-empty one at a different position.
